I will clear the work map and build a little spinning solar system on your desk.

spec.text: Flick with an open palm to spin the system. Pinch a planet to pause it and see its name.

events.text: Your solar system is on the desk, with all eight planets orbiting. Flick it with an open palm to spin it, and pinch a planet to see its name.
It's ready and spinning slowly. Pinch Earth, the blue planet, to pause it and see its name.

events.action: pinch empty space and swipe to spin

events.text: Earth is paused. Pinch it again when you want it moving.

notes: Unplanned request; the real build wait is visible from 4.2 ("Building it...") to 42.2 (run_code). The spin swipe is at ~81 and the Earth pinch at ~86.9 (Earth pauses and shows its name).
